events.text: Bingolotto premiered on Kållevisionen with Leif Loket Olsson as show host.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The show premiered on 16 January 1989 on the local TV channel Kållevisionen

events.text: Bingolotto premiered and Olsson introduced the game show to the people in the Gothenburg area.
events.subject: self

events.text: Gert Eklund started his collaboration with TV4 to start broadcasting the show nationwide.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the autumn of 1990 , the game shows owner and C.E.O . Gert Eklund started his collaboration with TV4

events.text: Olsson was bought out of the company.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: was bought of the company in 1999

events.text: Bingolotto premiered nationwide on TV4 with Leif Loket Olsson as show host.

events.quote: On 19 October 1991 , Bingolotto premiered nationwide on TV4

events.text: Loket received the television award The Lennart Hyland TV Prize for Best Male Show Host of the Year.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In 1992 , Loket received the television award The Lennart Hyland TV Prize

events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: Loket received this prize again in 1994

events.text: Loket received the prize Årets Göteborgare (Gothenburg Citizen of the Year).
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In 1993 , Loket received the prize Årets Göteborgare

events.text: Olsson was replaced by Lasse Kronér.
